steps: Apply online at bankofhope.com (or book an appointment) for a Bank Simply Checking account with College Banking benefits.
Sign agreements and fund the account within 10 calendar days ($25 minimum to open).
Within the first 60 days, make 10 or more debit card purchases with a physical or digital card.
Keep the account open and in good standing until the bonus is paid.
Receive the $125 bonus credited to checking within 30 days after the 60-day qualification period.
